title: Text Editor with Undo/Redo
description:
```
> insert 0 Hello
> insert 5 , World
> print       → Hello, World
> delete 0 7
> undo        → Hello, World
> redo        → World
```
requirements: Each edit is a `unique_ptr<Command>`-like struct with enough data to undo (use structs + `enum class` type for now; polymorphism comes in M08)
Undo and redo stacks (`std::vector`), redo cleared on new edits
Commands are **moved** between stacks, never copied
